items.label: >7-Pots Plant Stand
items.value: Featuring a ladder design that allows unobstructed sunlight, this plant rack accommodates more than 7 pots, making it an ideal decorative piece for organizing your plant collection. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use.

items.label: Multifunctional Application
items.value: Natural Living Space: Transform any space - living room, bedroom, office, or balcony - into a vibrant paradise. This versatile plant stand not only serves as a decorative and storage shelf but also showcases your precious plants.

items.label: Durable and Sturdy
items.value: This plant stand requires no screws, making it perfect for DIY enthusiasts. Utilizing the clever application of the triangular stability principle, it enhances stability. Additionally, plastic joints reinforce the structure of the plant stand, ensuring its durability.

items.label: Carbonized Natural Wood
items.value: The eucalyptus wood, treated at 570°F for carbonization, enhances waterproof performance and extends the lifespan (though outdoor lifespan may be slightly shorter).

items.label: Easy Installation, Detailed Instructions
items.value: Simple setup with clear instructions. Enjoy the beautiful decoration and functionality of this plant stand right away - perfect for beginners!

items.label: Special Features
items.value: Tiered ladder design for 7 pots, carbonized wood, 180-day warranty
